plugin.description: Passively records every housing lottery bid you place, per character, by reading the placard when you interact with it. One row per bid: character/world, region, district, ward, plot, size, FC-vs-personal, entry date, results-available date with live countdown, and outcome (Pending/Won/Lost). Auto-captures placard data during entry and results periods; auto-detects wins via the results SelectYesno; entry number is grabbed when shown and editable otherwise. Sortable table with click-to-expand details, per-column toggles, editable notes, and optional shared storage across all clients. Open with /hlt (alias /lotto).
